title: ⚠️ Some Channels May Not Work in Chrome
body:
Some channels, including certain Sony Sports, Sony MAX, and Zee Action streams, may experience playback issues in Chrome.

This can happen because of browser compatibility, streaming restrictions, or changes made by the broadcaster.

✅ What You Can Try:
- Refresh the channel page.
- Try another supported browser, such as [Via Browser](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=mark.via.gp).
- Check again later if the stream is temporarily unavailable.

📌 Not every channel is affected, and switching browsers does not guarantee playback.

title: 🌐 Native Language Names Updated
body:
FreeTV Garden supports 74 native languages, with language names displayed in their respective scripts where supported.

✨ Explore channels using familiar language names and discover content from different countries and regions.

title: 🎧 Background Playback Support
body:
Enjoy supported streams with background playback capabilities.

📱 Depending on your device, browser, and the channel's player, audio may continue playing when you switch tabs or use other apps.

📌 Background playback is not supported by every channel or browser.

title: 🌍 Explore FreeTV Garden in 74 Languages
body:
FreeTV Garden supports 74 interface languages, helping users worldwide explore live TV more comfortably.

Discover channels across 200+ countries, with 1,000+ live TV channels and a wide variety of channel languages and categories.

title: ⚠️ Important: Channel Availability
body:
Some TV channels may not work at all times or in every location.

📡 Why a channel may not work:
- The original stream may be offline or temporarily unavailable.
- The broadcaster may have changed its streaming link.
- Geographic restrictions may apply.
- Some streams may not work in certain browsers.

🔄 Channel availability can change without notice. Try another browser or check again later if a stream does not load.

📩 If you encounter a persistent problem, report it through our community or contact email.
